posts.title: BloomBox 3.2.1 · A cleaner Home 🌸
posts.text: Meet the redesigned Home! Eight shortcuts in two rows for APK Store, App Store, Themes, Modules, SideStore, Files, RAM+ and Settings. A smaller matte Profiles panel, compact News and recognizable Google Play, App Store and SideStore icons. Blank store icons have been fixed. Download 3.2.1 from GitHub Releases.

posts.title: BloomBox 3.2.0 · Ports & RAM+ 🎮
posts.text: Android and iPhone port catalogs, RAM+ improvements and installer updates have arrived. Husk game compatibility is verified separately; some known issues remain unresolved.

posts.title: BloomBox 2.0 · Your desktop, your rules 🫧
posts.text: Freeform widgets are coming: photos, animated GIFs and adjustable sizes among your apps.

posts.text: The icon wave is in testing. This section updates from GitHub without reinstalling the IPA.
